result:
I found no bugs or regressions in the patch, and its Continue behaviour matches native ordinary Continue. I only read the code; I didn't run the tests, so the pass/fail counts below are the author's.

```json
{
  "verdict": "NO_FINDINGS",
  "findings": [],
  "ContinueParity": {
    "native": "field_warp_tasks.c:434-439: when Flag966 is not set, Continue calls EnterLocation(NULL), LoadMapMatrixAndMode, StartBugContestTimer and RestorePlayerAndMapObjects, and never calls FieldSystem_InitMapOnEnter. So it skips OnTransition (line 268), the temp-data clear, ResetStateOnWarp (where Flash/Defog are cleared), Gymmick_Clear and the blackout-spawn update (262-267). fieldmap.c:189 and :213 still run OnLoad and then OnResume. New Game (387-414) does call InitMapOnEnter(FALSE).",
    "host": "main.ts:257-258 only allows 'continue' as a non-connection entry with restoreObjects=true. Line 271 skips the Flash/Defog clear and mapBlackoutSpawn when continuing and still calls objects.restore. Line 280 picks 'resume', which maps to ['OnLoad','OnResume'] (field-transitions.ts:22). gymFieldEntry gets restoreObjects=true, so the saved fieldHeight and Violet liftState reach world.enter and are not deleted. Warp, connection, whiteout and scriptWarp calls (302, 313, 340, 446) keep the default 'warp' and are unchanged.",
    "titleSelection": "runOpeningSession (opening.ts:95) returns `saved` by identity for Continue; New Game always returns createState(identity), a new object. A null save never equals the new state, so `state===saved` (main.ts:444) is a sound test.",
    "newGameDelta": "begin('warp') now passes restoreObjects=false where it used to pass true. For a fresh newState the old restore did nothing. Now gymFieldEntry clears fieldHeight/gymmick, which matches native Save_Gymmick_Clear in InitMapOnEnter. OnTransition, Flash clear and spawn still run as before. No regression.",
    "violetContinue": "T22GYM0101 only has an OnTransition script (VioletGymInit plus Falkner phone temps), so on Continue no script runs. The platform is placed by world.enter → VioletGym.enter using the saved liftState, and state.gymmick is kept. This matches native, where Continue keeps the saved gymmick and does not run OnTransition. A side effect: a Continue save in the gym with no gymmick no longer gets {violet,0} synthesized. ride() sets it anyway, so this is harmless.",
    "testQuality": [
      "Strong: enterMap, runFieldEntry, title and begin are taken verbatim from main.ts and run with the real ScriptVM, FieldObjects, SourceActionRecovery and native map JSON.
```
